chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Carney Roberts, clarinet player and teacher
summary: Collette asks about clarinetist Carney Roberts; Howard knows only that he played around and taught, and met him around 1921-22.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

This is May 8th, 1978, speaking with Mr. Paul L. Howard.

Now, he's a guy I know who taught a dear friend of mine, Jimmy Kelso, how to play the clarinet, and he's a guy I always like to know more about, because he was one of my early influences.

In the beginning?
